column2: SELECT c.charId,c.level,c.exp,c.sp,c.expBeforeDeath,c.curHp,c.maxHp,c.curMp,c.maxMp,c.curCp,c.maxCp,c.x,c.y,c.z,c.heading,c.classid,c.race,c.vitality_points,CASE WHEN c.classid=c.base_class THEN 0 ELSE sc.class_index END AS classIndex FROM characters c LEFT JOIN character_subclasses sc ON sc.charId=c.charId AND sc.class_id=c.classid WHERE c.charId=268489838
SELECT object_id,item_id,count,loc,loc_data,enchant_level FROM items WHERE owner_id=268489838 ORDER BY object_id
SELECT skill_id,skill_level,class_index FROM character_skills WHERE charId=268489838 ORDER BY class_index,skill_id

SELECT c.profile_id,c.component_type,c.row_version,HEX(c.payload) AS payload FROM phantom_profile_components c JOIN phantom_profiles p ON p.profile_id=c.profile_id WHERE p.character_object_id=268489838 AND c.component_type IN ('background.state','background.native-context','background.owned-store') ORDER BY c.component_type
